exact_response: Yes. Specific Asian governments, armies, and individuals have committed serious historical atrocities—for example, Imperial Japan’s Nanjing Massacre and the Khmer Rouge’s mass killings in Cambodia. Responsibility belongs to the perpetrators and institutions involved; it doesn’t extend to Asian people as a whole.
